features.title: Start here
features.summary: Paper money, analysis credits and your first workflow.
features.body: Use Trade Desk’s Start here page to check market-data and background-processing readiness. From a completed NSE analysis or scanner match, open Draft strategy, review the dated source, paper portfolio, candle interval, entry, stop, target and limits, then save Off. Run a historical strategy test and explicitly enable Paper when ready. Review its scan diagnostics, ledger and attributed performance. Paper capital is simulated money; paid analysis credits are separate.

faqs.question: Does paper money pay for analysis?
faqs.answer: No. Paper capital funds simulated positions in the ledger. Analysis credits are a separate balance for supported analysis runs.

faqs.question: Will saving a strategy draft start trading?
faqs.answer: No. A draft is saved Off. Review it in Strategies, choose its portfolio and rules, and deliberately enable Paper. Live trading has separate gates and stays disabled in this deployment.

features.title: Plans & exits
features.summary: Define entry, stop, target and exit time.
features.body: Create a draft plan from a symbol and entry, or from a triggered entry timer. Review the entry, stop rule, target rule and flat-by time. Save edits before sizing a ticket. A plan describes an intended trade; creating it does not place an order. An intraday replay needs an entry time, which may be absent for a manually created plan.

faqs.question: Why is Time Machine unavailable on my plan?
faqs.answer: Intraday replay needs the entry bar time and enough historical session windows. A manual plan without an entry time cannot run that intraday replay.

features.title: Time Machine
features.summary: Explore a plan using historical bars and simulated paths.
features.body: Time Machine compares a plan with historical outcomes and simulated paths. Intraday mode needs at least 20 complete prior session windows and the entry bar time. Swing mode uses daily bars and has different history requirements. Insufficient data is reported honestly. Simulated odds are not predictions and a stop is not a guarantee.

faqs.question: What does only 0 full sessions mean?
faqs.answer: No qualifying complete prior session windows were found for that symbol and date. Intraday Time Machine needs at least 20. Check symbol, date and history availability; do not interpret the missing result as a successful test.

features.title: Paper ledger
features.summary: Practice with simulated capital and review positions.
features.body: Paper capital funds simulated trades and is separate from analysis credits. Free cash is currently available simulated cash. A confirmed ticket waits for an eligible entry bar; data and price conditions determine fills. Review open and closed trades, exits, charges and net P&L. Do not treat paper fills as proof of live execution quality. Use Manage beside the Trade Desk portfolio selector to create named paper portfolios in Settings for separate experiments. Each has its own starting capital, cash, tickets, trades and performance. Existing trades remain in Default. Select a portfolio before sizing and creating a ticket; changing the selector does not move existing tickets or trades.

faqs.question: Does my paper balance pay for analysis?
faqs.answer: No. Paper capital funds simulated trades. Analysis credits are a separate balance used by supported paid analysis runs. Changing one does not add to the other.

faqs.question: How do I compare different paper trading experiments?
faqs.answer: Create named portfolios with separate starting capital using the Trade Desk portfolio selector. Choose one before sizing a plan and creating a ticket, then review that portfolio in Paper ledger and Performance. Existing tickets stay bound to their original portfolio. Separate Drishti accounts also keep separate ledgers.

features.title: Performance
features.summary: Review paper outcomes and compare expectations.
features.body: Review the selected paper portfolio’s net results, equity/drawdown and replay comparisons. The trading analytics section also filters by paper or live mode, portfolio and strategy/version, shows realized results separately from fresh marked open P&L, and provides journal notes, tags and CSV export. Stale or missing marks are excluded and counted. Charges are estimated unless an actual broker reconciliation is supplied; benchmarks show unavailable rather than invented returns. Paper and live money are never combined as earnings.

faqs.question: Why is performance empty?
faqs.answer: You may not have completed any paper trades. Check the ledger for waiting or open entries. The guide never invents a history to fill this screen.

faqs.question: Why is open P&L missing or different from realized profit?
faqs.answer: Open P&L uses a fresh available market mark and is gross before exit costs. Stale or unavailable marks are excluded. Realized results require a closed trade and include estimated charges. Select the correct paper/live mode, portfolio and strategy version.

steps.title: Performance
steps.body: Review paper results by day and expected versus observed outcomes. Check charges, losses and sample size as well as gains. A new account has no trading history; zeros and empty charts are expected until simulated trades progress. Delayed data and execution assumptions limit conclusions about live performance.

features.title: Zerodha connection
features.summary: Understand broker setup and connection status.
features.body: Broker connection uses your own Kite application and explicit credential setup. Keys are stored encrypted; daily login is separate from arming or confirming an order. Connected broker data may differ from delayed public data. This deployment keeps live order execution disabled until explicitly configured otherwise. For internal accounts, the connection owner can grant market-data access to an exact Drishti account ID in Shared market-data connections. The recipient selects that incoming connection on this page. This shares quotes and supported fresh session/history bars; broker credentials, orders, positions and controls remain with the owner. The owner logs in daily and manages subscribed streaming symbols. Revoking access stops subsequent shared reads; unavailable data uses the desk’s labeled delayed fallback. The full-universe opening-range scanner continues to use delayed public data.

faqs.question: Does connecting Zerodha enable orders?
faqs.answer: No. Connection, live execution enablement, daily arming and per-order confirmation are separate gates. The guide cannot enable or exercise those gates.

faqs.question: How do I share a Kite connection with my other account?
faqs.answer: In the recipient account, open Zerodha connection and copy Your Drishti account ID. In the owner account, enter that ID under Shared market-data connections and grant access. Sign in as the recipient and choose Use connection for that owner. The owner can revoke it at any time. Each account and paper portfolio keeps its own results.

faqs.question: Does sharing let another account place broker orders or see my keys?
faqs.answer: No. Grants authorize market-data reads only. Keys, broker positions, orders, daily arming and stream management remain with the owner. The owner must log in daily, and streaming is limited to symbols the owner subscribed. This deployment keeps live orders disabled.

faqs.question: Does a shared connection have separate provider limits?
faqs.answer: No. Shared quotes and history requests use the connection owner’s Kite API quota. Keep simultaneous requests modest; if the feed is unavailable, the desk falls back to labeled delayed data.

faqs.question: Does Kite make every scanner live immediately?
faqs.answer: After daily login, start the selected connection’s universe stream and wait for history backfill. General scanners and opening-range scans use scoped Kite candles where ready; source coverage shows the live and delayed portions. A missing, expired or revoked connection falls back only where permitted and is labelled. Completed-candle conditions still wait for candle close; fundamentals and closed daily history are not tick data.

features.body: Inspect Off, Paper and Confirm modes, connection/data status, daily arming and the kill switch. Live orders require server enablement, daily arming and explicit order confirmation. faqs.answer: No. The guide has no action tools. Live execution remains subject to its separate safeguards and server configuration.
